title: Senior Legal Project Lead – Contract Data Extraction | Fixed Term Contract
description:
Join Basware's Legal \& Sourcing team on\-site in Chandigarh, leading a 3\-person contract data extraction team — yourself plus two junior legal/paralegal analysts — reporting to the Global Contract Data Lead. The team builds a clean, source\-attributed dataset from Basware's customer contracts, starting with our VIP, Strategic and Key segments, using an AI\-assisted extraction platform (tool selection pending). You'll set up the methodology in week one, then run daily production: extracting and QA'ing contracts, training and supporting the two analysts, resolving complex cases, correcting AI output, and partnering with our IT project lead on tooling.
   

  

 ,
   

  

 – Fully fluent in English (written and spoken), including legal/commercial terminology
   

  

 – Strong working knowledge of commercial contracts (SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, amendments, SOWs) from a legal, paralegal or contracts\-management background
   

  

 – Experience leading or mentoring a small team, ideally in legal ops, contracts or shared services
   

  

 – Hands\-on comfort with AI\-assisted software tools; able to evaluate AI output critically rather than accept it at face value
   

  

 – Strong working proficiency in Microsoft tools (Excel, Word, SharePoint, Teams)
   

  

 – High attention to detail; comfortable working to a structured data schema and daily throughput targets
   

  

 – Process\-oriented, able to build a repeatable methodology from a blank page
   

  

 – Willing to work on\-site at the Chandigarh office and collaborate directly with the IT project lead
   

  

 – Nice to have: prior exposure to AI\-assisted contract/legal\-tech platforms, experience reconciling CRM or billing/provisioning data, familiarity with SaaS commercial terms
